description: Finds the average (arithmetic mean) for the cells specified by a given set of conditions or criteria.

params.description: The actual cells to be used to find the average.
params.name: arg1

params.description: The first range of cells which will be evaluated for the specific condition.
params.name: arg2

params.description: The first condition or criteria in the form of a number, expression, or text that defines which cells will be used to find the average.
params.name: arg3

params.description: Up to 126 additional ranges which will be evaluated for the specific conditions. These arguments are optional.
params.name: arg4

params.description: Up to 126 additional conditions or criteria for the corresponding ranges. These arguments are optional.
params.name: arg5

signature: AVERAGEIFS(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName, arg2: ApiRange | ApiName, arg3: ApiRange | ApiName | number | string, arg4?: ApiRange | ApiName, arg5?: ApiRange | ApiName | number | string): number
